subproblem.title: Fubini–Tonelli on the cylinder (0,1) × A ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} (supplied step 2(b)–(c))
subproblem.statement: Let n ∈ ℕ and let A ⊆ ℝⁿ (Euclid n) be Borel. Write ι(t, u) := (t, u_1, …, u_n) ∈ ℝ^{n+1} (Lean WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u))), z_0 := WithLp.ofLp z 0, tail z := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) ∈ ℝⁿ, and Â := {z ∈ ℝ^{n+1} : z_0 ∈ (0, 1) and tail z ∈ A}. All measures are Lebesgue measure (volume). Then (a) Â is Borel; (b) for every Borel f : ℝ^{n+1} → [0, ∞], ∫⁻_Â f = ∫⁻_{u ∈ A} ∫⁻_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du; (c) for every f : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ integrable on Â, ∫_Â f = ∫_{u ∈ A} ∫_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du.
subproblem.lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : Set (Euclid n)), MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} ∧ (∀ f : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable f → ∫⁻ z in {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A}, f z = ∫⁻ u in A, ∫⁻ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, f (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)))) ∧ ∀ f : Euclid (n + 1) → ℝ, IntegrableOn f {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} → ∫ z in {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A}, f z = ∫ u in A, ∫ t in Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1, f (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)))
subproblem.natural_proof:
Source: step 2(b)–(c) of the parent's supplied proof (product pieces and the Fubini identity), proved here for an arbitrary Borel A.
Notation. ℝ^m := Euclid m = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) with Lebesgue measure volume. For z ∈ ℝ^{m+1}: z_0 := WithLp.ofLp z 0 and tail z := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) ∈ ℝ^m. For t ∈ ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m: ι(t, x) := WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)) ∈ ℝ^{m+1}, so that ι(t, x)_0 = t, tail ι(t, x) = x and z = ι(z_0, tail z) (Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.cons_self_tail, WithLp.ofLp_toLp, WithLp.toLp_ofLp). e₀ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1 ∈ ℝ^{N+1}; ê_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 ∈ ℝ^{n+1}; e_b := EuclideanSpace.single b 1 ∈ ℝ^n; J x := ι(0, x) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp x)) for x ∈ ℝ^N. DH(z) := fderiv ℝ H z, and DH(z)ê denotes the tuple a ↦ DH(z) ê_a. |α| := covectorEuclideanNorm α.

Proof. Fix n and a Borel set A ⊆ ℝⁿ.
1. (The splitting map.) Define e : ℝⁿ × ℝ → ℝ^{n+1} as the composite of four measurable equivalences: (i) the swap (u, t) ↦ (t, u) (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm); (ii) id × ofLp : ℝ × Euclid n → ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ) (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin n → ℝ)).symm); (iii) the inverse of MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0, which sends (t, p) to Fin.insertNth 0 t p = Fin.cons t p (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNth_zero'); (iv) toLp : (Fin (n+1) → ℝ) → Euclid (n+1) (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin (n+1) → ℝ)). Evaluating the composite, e(u, t) = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp u)) = ι(t, u). Being a composite of measurable equivalences, e is a measurable equivalence, in particular a measurable embedding, and its inverse is measurable.
2. (Measure preservation.) Each factor is measure preserving for the volume measures (volume on a product is the product measure): (i) by Measure.measurePreserving_swap; (ii) by MeasurePreserving.prod of MeasurePreserving.id and EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin n) (ofLp carries volume on Euclid n to the product Lebesgue measure on Fin n → ℝ); (iii) volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ => ℝ) 0 says piFinSuccAbove is measure preserving, hence so is its inverse (MeasurePreserving.symm); (iv) the inverse of the measure-preserving ofLp on Euclid (n+1) (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin (n+1)) with MeasurePreserving.symm). By MeasurePreserving.comp, e is measure preserving from volume on ℝⁿ × ℝ (= volume ⊗ volume, Measure.volume_eq_prod) to volume on ℝ^{n+1}.
3. (Preimage of Â.) For (u, t) ∈ ℝⁿ × ℝ we have e(u, t)_0 = t and tail e(u, t) = u, so e(u, t) ∈ Â iff u ∈ A and t ∈ (0, 1). Hence e⁻¹(Â) = A × (0, 1).
4. (Part (a).) Since e is a bijection, step 3 gives Â = (e⁻¹)⁻¹(A × (0, 1)). The set A × (0, 1) is measurable (A Borel, (0,1) open) and e⁻¹ is measurable, so Â is Borel.
5. (Part (b).) Let f be Borel. By change of variables along the measure-preserving measurable embedding e (MeasurePreserving.setLIntegral_comp_preimage_emb), ∫⁻_Â f dλ^{n+1} = ∫⁻_{e⁻¹(Â)} f(e(p)) d(λⁿ ⊗ λ¹)(p) = ∫⁻_{A × (0,1)} f(e(u, t)) d(λⁿ ⊗ λ¹). The function f ∘ e is measurable, so Tonelli's theorem on the product set (setLIntegral_prod) turns this into ∫⁻_{u ∈ A} ∫⁻_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(e(u, t)) dt du = ∫⁻_{u ∈ A} ∫⁻_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du.
6. (Part (c).) Let f be integrable on Â. Integrability transfers along e (MeasurePreserving.integrableOn_comp_preimage): f ∘ e is integrable on e⁻¹(Â) = A × (0, 1) for λⁿ ⊗ λ¹. Change of variables (MeasurePreserving.setIntegral_preimage_emb) gives ∫_Â f = ∫_{A × (0,1)} f(e(u, t)) d(λⁿ ⊗ λ¹), and Fubini's theorem on the product set (setIntegral_prod, using the integrability just proved) gives ∫_{u ∈ A} ∫_{t ∈ (0,1)} f(ι(t, u)) dt du. ∎

Appendix (supplementary; the numbered argument above is complete without it). The following Lean proof of exactly this frozen statement was checked with `lake env lean` after `import GMT.Ch07.Submission`, inside `namespace GMT.Ch07` with the contract's opens and `noncomputable section`, with the declaration named Submission.X as in accepted nodes. Its axioms are propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound only, and sibling theorems are referenced by their Submission. names.
Lean tactic block for `theorem Submission.cmcdt_lpi_cyl_fubini`, whose type is exactly the frozen lean_statement of this child (it follows `:= by`):
  intro n A hA
  set Ah := {z : Euclid (n + 1) | WithLp.ofLp z 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.tail (WithLp.ofLp z)) : Euclid n) ∈ A} with hAh_def
  -- the measurable equivalence Euclid n × ℝ ≃ᵐ Euclid (n+1), (u, t) ↦ (t, u)
  let e : (Euclid n × ℝ) ≃ᵐ Euclid (n + 1) :=
    (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm.trans
      ((MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ) (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin n → ℝ)).symm).trans
        (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm)).trans
      (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ))
  have he : ∀ p : Euclid n × ℝ, e p = WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons p.2 (WithLp.ofLp p.1)) := by
    rintro ⟨u, t⟩
    simp [e, MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove_symm_apply, Fin.insertNthEquiv, Fin.insertNth_zero']
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  have hmp : MeasurePreserving e volume volume := by
    have h1 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodComm : (Euclid n × ℝ) ≃ᵐ (ℝ × Euclid n)) volume volume :=
      Measure.measurePreserving_swap
    have h2 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.prodCongr (MeasurableEquiv.refl ℝ) (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin n → ℝ)).symm) volume volume :=
      (MeasurePreserving.id volume).prod (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin n))
    have h3 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm volume volume :=
      (volume_preserving_piFinSuccAbove (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ) 0).symm _
    have h4 : MeasurePreserving (MeasurableEquiv.toLp 2 (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)) volume volume := by
      have := (EuclideanSpace.volume_preserving_symm_measurableEquiv_toLp (Fin (n + 1))).symm _
      simpa using this
    exact h4.comp (h3.comp (h2.comp h1))
  have hpre : e ⁻¹' Ah = A ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    ext ⟨u, t⟩
    simp [Ah, he, and_comm]
  have hAhm : MeasurableSet Ah := by
    have : Ah = e.symm ⁻¹' (A ×ˢ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1) := by
      rw [← hpre]; ext z; simp
    rw [this]
    exact e.symm.measurable (hA.prod measurableSet_Ioo)
  refine ⟨hAhm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro f hf
    rw [← hmp.setLIntegral_comp_preimage_emb e.measurableEmbedding f Ah, hpre]
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, setLIntegral_prod]
    · simp only [he]
    · exact (hf.comp e.measurable).aemeasurable
  · intro f hf
    rw [← hmp.setIntegral_preimage_emb e.measurableEmbedding f Ah, hpre]
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod, setIntegral_prod]
    · simp only [he]
    · rw [← Measure.volume_eq_prod, ← hpre]
      exact (hmp.integrableOn_comp_preimage e.measurableEmbedding).2 hf
proof_key_steps: e(u, t) := ι(t, u) is the composite swap, id × ofLp, (piFinSuccAbove · 0)⁻¹ (= Fin.cons) and toLp, so e is a measurable equivalence ℝⁿ × ℝ ≃ᵐ ℝ^{n+1}.
Each factor is measure preserving, so e carries volume ⊗ volume to volume.
e⁻¹(Â) = A × (0, 1), hence Â = (e⁻¹)⁻¹(A × (0, 1)) is Borel.
Change of variables along e plus Tonelli on A × (0, 1) gives the lintegral identity (b).
Integrability transfers along e; change of variables plus Fubini on A × (0, 1) gives the integral identity (c).
